description: Default source-loader options of the yamlprims specification revision 1.5 with merge_keys = AsKey (section 5.3): YAML 1.2.2 Core resolution (section 4), integers limited to i128::MIN..=u128::MAX, explicit core tags directing resolution, non-core tags retained with a raw string inner, duplicate keys rejected (section 5.2), strict flow indentation in every parsing pass (section 9), and single-document entrypoints. Error kinds are the specification's snake_case ErrorKind names. Retained source-loader policy fields and section 4.4 !!merge expectations match revision 1.4; revision 1.5 adds checked caller-tree constructors and symmetric wire decoding (1.5/E-1), the Core YAML emitter and Serde serialization (1.5/E-2), the RFC 7493 I-JSON projection (1.5/E-3), and multi-language architecture alignment (1.5/E-4). This file carries no cases.
